title: Taipei City Launches Subsidy Program for Accessibility Improvements in Existing Residential Buildings - gov.taipei
summary: Taipei City begins accepting applications for subsidies to improve accessibility facilities in existing residential buildings for the 115th fiscal year.
body:
Taipei City begins accepting applications for subsidies to improve accessibility facilities in existing residential buildings for the 115th fiscal year.

title: South Korea’s First Large-Scale Accessible Facility Allows Free Enjoyment of Fitness and Hair Services
summary: South Korea has opened its first large-scale accessible facility where people with disabilities can freely enjoy fitness and hairdressing services, promoting inclusive lifestyle access.
body:
South Korea has opened its first large-scale accessible facility where people with disabilities can freely enjoy fitness and hairdressing services, promoting inclusive lifestyle access.

Read more from the original source: [中央社 CNA](https://www.cna.com.tw/news/aopl/202603180335.aspx)
